svg.title: Without a verification and fix loop you are the loop; with one the agent is
svg.desc: Two lanes. Top lane, without a verification and fix loop: the AI agent writes code, the person runs the plan and waits, the plan fails, the person copies the error back into the chat, and the agent fixes it. The person is in the middle of every round. Bottom lane, with a verification and fix loop: in the same time the agent runs the plan itself four times, fails three, passes on the fourth attempt, and hands the person a pull request with the run link and plan summary. The person only appears at the end.

g.text: Without a verification and fix loop
With a verification and fix loop
the agent runs the check; you review the result
Same change. The person moves from inside the loop to the end of it.
